about.title: About & Downloads
about.description: What {brand} is and how to use it, bulk HD image and dataset downloads, and CC BY 4.0 attribution.
about.lead: 350 layout and composition reference posters, each covering one technique: what it is, its key points, and when to use it. Organized into {cats} categories and {subs} topics—searchable, downloadable, and ready to prompt with.
about.how1: Click a category tab in the Atlas, or search from the top bar by name, ID, English title, key points, or keywords.
about.how2: Open any poster to inspect it large; click the image for actual size so fine print stays legible. Switch between versions where a second version exists.
about.how3: Download HD (WebP, 1086 × 1448) or Copy composition prompt—a concise description of the layout ready to append to your image prompt.
about.how4: Favorite candidate layouts as you work, then open Favorites in the Atlas to copy your shortlist (ID + name) in one click. Favorites are saved locally in this browser.
about.zip: All 350 HD posters (ZIP): original PNGs via GitHub Releases.
about.zip100: Classic 100 set (ZIP): the original “100 Layouts” collection.
about.data: Catalog data: CSV (for spreadsheets) · JSON (for scripts and apps). Includes ID, name, category, topic, image path, dimensions, and SHA-256.
about.licenseText: Images and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0: you may share, adapt, and use them commercially as long as you give credit and indicate any changes. Suggested attribution:
about.textBody: Definitions, key points, usage notes, and keywords on detail pages are transcribed directly from the posters: two models transcribed each poster independently, fields were diffed, and mismatches were reviewed by hand. Nothing was added beyond the poster text. Spot a mistake? Report it on GitHub Issues.
about.translated: The interface and poster text in this language were AI-translated from Chinese; the poster images themselves remain in Chinese. Spot a translation issue? Let us know on GitHub Issues.
about.vip: Member site: Xiaoxiaodong Member Prompt Library
